name: universal-ai-skills
description: Router-first AI skill system for Codex, Claude, Cursor, Hermes, Paperclip, OpenCode, and local AI stacks: search, preflight-route, and load skills on demand without duplicating the corpus.

interface.longDescription: Plan multi-skill workflows, search, and load relevant skills on demand from the shared canonical skill corpus. Skills stay in the repository under skills/ instead of being copied into every AI client or injected into always-loaded context.
